description: This file defines an interface containing constant values used across various controllers in a Java-based web application, specifically in the shopizer project. It organizes string constants related to view names, URL redirects, and identifiers for different pages and sections such as shopping cart, category, product, customer, content, merchant, checkout, and search.

classes.name: ControllerConstants
classes.description: Interface containing constant string values used throughout the shopizer web application controllers.
